schema.description: Under which accounts the listed contributions of one ban were recorded; never who caused the ban. Codes are computed on unredacted rows, so hidden identities never make an answer look exclusive.

contributing_accounts.description: Distinct recorded accounts of the listed contributions; null unless the caller has history_detail.

items.description: One counted increment recorded under the subject's account or login claim (its own data).

ban_active.description: The increment was counted while a ban was active.

attempt_id.description: The attempt of this page the request belongs to, if any.

matched_by.description: login_claim only means the same login name was typed; it cannot tell the customer from anybody else.

items.title: SupportHistorySubjectContribution

no_account.description: Claims that resolved to no account at capture time (often typos).

unresolved.description: Claims whose account was not recorded; aliases of the subject can hide here.

code.description: SUBJECT_ACCOUNT: contributions recorded under the requested account (a recorded account, never only the same login name), exclusive only with other_contributors none_observed. MULTIPLE_ACCOUNTS: under the requested and another recorded account. OTHER_ACCOUNTS_ONLY: only other recorded accounts with complete evidence and no unresolved, account-less, or subject-name claim. Otherwise NOT_SUFFICIENTLY_ATTRIBUTABLE.

schema.title: SupportHistoryBanAttribution
